svg.title: One run of the point machine monitor
svg.desc: Eight throws arrive from the monitoring unit. For each one the points move, the throw time fills a gauge with limits at 4 and 6 seconds, and the monitor sends any alert to the maintenance desk. Points P101 move in 3.2 seconds: ok, no alert. Points P101 move in 4.5 seconds: slow, warning. Points P102 move in 4.7 seconds: slow, warning. Points P101 move in 3.3 seconds: ok, no alert. Points P103 move in 4.4 seconds: slow, warning. Points P104 move in 4.6 seconds: slow, warning. Points P105 move in 4.8 seconds: slow, alarm. Points P102 move in 7.2 seconds: too slow, alarm.
